labels: The enzyme cuts both DNA strands at the same site
EcoRI cuts the DNA between bases G and A only when the sequence GAATTC is present in the DNA
DNA fragments join at sticky ends
note: Caption 'Figure 9.1 Steps in formation of recombinant DNA by action of restriction endonuclease enzyme - EcoRI' lies below target_box_in_crop (separate block) and was excluded; body text above the box also excluded. Base letters are printed one per cell in the drawing; each strand is given as one sequence string (vector top/bottom strands, then foreign top/bottom strands; vector sticky end G over CTTAA; foreign sticky end AATT with C and G). The flat list loses the flow: two DNAs cut by EcoR1 -> sticky ends -> join -> recombinant DNA. 'EcoR1' copied as printed (figure text above spells it EcoRI).
